## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to assert RCC-8 Non-Tangential Proper Part — a region lies entirely within another's interior; a specialization of [`gmeow:containedInLocation`](gmeow-containedInLocation.md) / [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), inverse of [`gmeow:rcc8ntppi`](gmeow-rcc8ntppi.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for tangential containment ([`gmeow:rcc8tpp`](gmeow-rcc8tpp.md)).

### How to use

- Assert exactly one RCC-8 relation per region pair; NTPP feeds the containment/part spine.
